title: Content reference
description: The content a record write was made for (contract C19): `page:<page id>@v<version number>` (a form of a published page version), `page:<page id>@draft` (an editor's preview, or a page that was never published) or `res:<resource type>:<item id>@v<item version>` (a version of a plugin item). Null: the write named none (a job, an import) or predates the reference.
